xsmall.$description: Draft, on a 5px base. Kbd, tiny chips.

small.$description: Draft. Count chips, the checkbox, skeleton lines, inline hit targets.

medium.$description: Draft. Buttons, inputs, chips, tooltips, menu items.

large.$description: Draft. Cards, popovers, hover cards, menus and listboxes.

xlarge.$description: Draft. No part yet: a sheet runs flush to the window's edge, and a dialog is xxlarge.

xxlarge.$description: Draft. Dialogs, the command palette, a drawer's free edge, spotlight cards.

selected.$description: The width used to indicate a selected element, such as an active tab or a chosen item.

focused.$description: The width used for the focus ring on interactive elements.

default.$description: The default width for all standard component borders and dividers.
